statement: In July 2025 Intel cancelled the German and Polish projects outright; incoming CEO Lip-Bu Tan cited insufficient customer commitments and the risk of spending tens of billions on capacity that might not pay off, alongside Q2 2025 revenue of USD 12.9bn and a net loss of USD 2.9bn.
note: Three sources, two roots: SRC-005 is a reprint of SRC-003's material. Effective independent = 2.
